I am writing this as a serious warning to other pet owners. My recent experience at Every Tail Vets was deeply upsetting, both in terms of clinical safety and professional ethics.

1. Critical Hygiene & Safety Concerns:
I was appalled by the lack of basic clinical hygiene during our consultation. The vet touched the door handle and proceeded to examine my cat’s infected eyes without washing or sanitising their hands. Most distressingly, the vet used their long fingernails to pick at the discharge in my cat’s eye. This is an unacceptable infection risk and could have easily scratched the cornea. I scrub my hands before gently cleaning my cat's eyes at home; I expect a professional vet to have far higher standards.

2. Lack of Financial Transparency:
As a "Care Club" member, I was shocked to find I was charged £57.65 for medications that retail online for only £17. On a previous visit, I was also charged £24 for an item that costs £8 elsewhere. Despite RCVS Supporting Guidance stating that vets should ensure clients are aware of their right to a written prescription, I was never informed of this option. Their website promises "upfront estimates" for members, but this was not provided.

3. Dismissive Customer Service & Unfair Fees:
When I raised these concerns, the response was patronising. They sent a "smiling emoji" 😊 while telling me that buying from them was "more cost-effective" because they charge an extortionate £23 PER ITEM for a written prescription.

Furthermore, when I chose to cancel my membership due to these safety and transparency failures, the practice attempted to penalise me financially. They insisted on retroactively charging me "full price" for all services previously covered by my membership (like vaccinations and nail clipping). These services were pre-paid entitlements under my subscription, not "extra benefits" to be clawed back. It is shocking that a practice attempts to punish a loyal member for leaving after their own medical and professional failures.

4. Impact on Loyalty:
I have already advised a friend who was planning to join the Care Club to look elsewhere, and they have now cancelled their plans. It is a shame that I am still a member here. I only hope that speaking up will not affect the way my cat is treated, as professional care should never be compromised by honest feedback.

James & the team at Every Tail Vets in Stratford honestly saved my cats life. Jack is a 19 year old cat and as you would expect from a family member who has been with us so long, is very much loved.

He became ill recently and I took him to my usual vets (in Wanstead) who kept him in overnight for 5 days, did every test imaginable but Jack still wasnt getting any better. When they started to talk about putting him to sleep I took him out of there and to Every Tails for a 2nd opinion.

I felt like James really listened to what I had to say, went thoroughly through Jack's medical history and came up with a treatment plan which started working in less than a day.  We've seen him improve slowly but surely each day and within the last hour James phoned and said his latest tests have come back all clear!

I don't want to disparage the other Veterinary practice as I'm sure they tried their best, but when I look at the fact that after a £4000 + bill and 5 days under their care they didn't know what was wrong with Jack and their advice was to put him to sleep, I'm very glad that Every Tail recently opened and allowed things to go a different way.

P.S: Don't be fooled that they seem like a small practice, its actually a blessing! You get a very personal (and caring) approach from the team from the moment you walk through the door and I couldn't recommend them more highly.

P.P.S: Look into their 'Care Club' membership. £195 per year for Unlimited Consultations, Annual Vaccinations and other perks?  I've paid more than that on a single trip to my previous vets!
